items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Lewis was in New Orleans at a place called the 25... Lewis was gone. That's when he gave me that job at the Vingdon. He gave me a lot of nice, good big jobs.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, he was ahead of Satch in his day, you know. Are you older? Hmm? And you were older than Lewis?
I'm older than Lewis, sure. You are? I'm four years older than Lewis. I'm supposed to be. Has anybody heard of how is Satch? He's doing better, Satch.
He's doing better, Satch. All right, more Satch.
